methods.description: Recount existing per-county 2018 CBF row geometry type and component fields for exact #1138 scope; inspect ZIP projection declaration. No overlay or transformation performed.

conclusions.text: Texas has 254 functioning county governments; the retained Census guide supports their county-government role and count. It does not supply Article V §18 text or county boundary geometry.
The 2018 CBF input contains 254 county records but 313 polygon components; 11 records are MultiPolygon. One row/feature is not necessarily one polygon component.
The CBF .prj declares NAD83 geographic coordinates. The legacy unqualified EPSG:4326 treatment is an undocumented NAD83-as-WGS84 approximation; no displacement or changed classification was measured.
Article V §18 actual bytes were not acquired from the official site; the prior and current responses are navigation shells. Restore text before making a verified constitutional citation.
The 24 historical geometry assessments, island completeness, Texas outline, and source-hash lineage remain unresolved/out of scope; this packet neither recomputes nor corrects those findings.
